newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk planes bomb suspected Kurdish rebel hideouts.
newsitem.headline: Turk planes bomb suspected Kurdish rebel hideouts.

text.p: Turkish air force F-4 planes bombed suspected Kurdistan Workers Party guerrilla positions in the eastern mountains on Wednesday, witnesses said.
There was no immediate word of casualties.
Villagers in the area told Reuters by telephone that the bombings caused a forest fire at Kutuderesi, a 30-km (20-mile) long ravine used as a rebel hideout.
Security sources say that another of the areas bombed is home to around 300 guerrillas who have gathered there in recent weeks.
More than 26,000 people have been killed in the 12-year-old conflict between troops and the rebels, fighting for Kurdish self-rule in southeast Turkey.
